commands:
cat > docker-compose.yml <<'EOF'
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: planevent-db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: planevent
      POSTGRES_USER: planevent
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: planevent
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U planevent -d planevent"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  backendservice:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: src/PlaNEvent.Api/Dockerfile
    container_name: planevent-backend
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      ASPNETCORE_URLS: http://+:8080
      ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection: Host=db;Port=5432;Database=planevent;Username=planevent;Password=planevent
      ClientUrl: https://localhost
      BootstrapAdmin__Email: admin@planevent.local
      BootstrapAdmin__Password: Admin123!

  clientapp:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: src/PlaNEvent.Client/Dockerfile
    container_name: planevent-client
    depends_on:
      - backendservice

  reverseproxy:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    container_name: planevent-proxy
    depends_on:
      - clientapp
      - backendservice
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - nginx-certs:/etc/nginx/certs
    command: >
      /bin/sh -c "apk add --no-cache openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
      [ -f /etc/nginx/certs/planevent.crt ] ||
      openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 3650
      -keyout /etc/nginx/certs/planevent.key
      -out /etc/nginx/certs/planevent.crt
      -subj '/CN=PlaNEvent';
      nginx -g 'daemon off;'"

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  nginx-certs:
EOF
